mappings.note: Both contain the title/heading: 'En læresalme av David... En bønn' vs 'Maskil (cantique) de David... prière'. The content matches perfectly.
Translation v2 ('Je crie...') corresponds to the second half of OSMAIN v1 ('Med min røst roper jeg...'). The first half (title) is in Translation v1.
Translation v3 ('Je répands...') matches OSMAIN v2 ('Jeg utøser min klage...'). The content is identical in meaning and structure.
Translation v4 ('Quand mon esprit...') matches OSMAIN v3 ('Når min ånd forgår...'). Both contain the two clauses regarding the spirit and the snare.
Translation v5 ('Regarde à ma droite...') matches OSMAIN v4 ('Se deg om til høyre...'). The content regarding looking right and lack of refuge is identical.
Translation v6 ('Éternel! je crie...') matches OSMAIN v5 ('Jeg roper til deg...'). Both declare God as refuge and portion in the land of the living.
Translation v7 ('Sois attentif...') matches OSMAIN v6 ('Lytt til mitt rop...'). Both express weakness and the plea for deliverance from stronger pursuers.
Translation v8 ('Retire mon âme...') matches OSMAIN v7 ('Før meg ut av fengselet...'). Both contain the plea to be led out of prison and the promise that the righteous will gather.
